name: Autoregressive RDE value-repair source-association and resume gate
scope: Engineering TRAIN fixtures only, no efficacy scoring or full training authorization

updates.teacher: After each student forward, exactly re-encode its own predicted native source with the actual captured high-resolution input. Encode that same source with GT mask and native source-presence logit as a detached target for future loss. Keep target cache separate from predicted bank; prune only by native next-read schedule.

must_pass: First query native/zero memory output hash exact
All four native layers, alignment and positional checks
Causal teacher frames and exact object ID/source memory/score association
Student bank uses only its own predicted writes; teacher encoding cannot change it
Changing teacher targets cannot change the same student prediction/write before optimization
Frozen SAM2 unchanged and adapter gradients finite
After step8 atomically checkpoint bank, detached teacher cache, adapter, optimizer and RNG; steps9/10 replay exactly
Fresh-process replay of the same two updates before efficacy
